in_marathi.name: जगदीश
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: जगदीश हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। जगत् (jagat) meaning the universe and ईश (Ish) meaning god or ruler, thus जगदीश (Jagadish) means the lord of the universe. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Vishnu who is believed to rule and protect the universe.

in_bengali.name: जगदीश
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: जगदीश একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। जगत् (jagat) meaning the universe and ईश (Ish) meaning god or ruler, thus जगदीश (Jagadish) means the lord of the universe. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Lord Vishnu who is believed to rule and protect the universe.
